notes: Third request (skip=100) past the end of the spotify site: HTTP 200 with the body [] (two bytes), kept whole. Documented (https://github.com/lever/postings-api): a public read API, HTTPS only, "Only published postings are public ... These jobs may be scraped by third parties"; the only documented rate limit is on application POSTs (not used). robots.txt of both api.lever.co and api.eu.lever.co: User-agent * / Allow: / / Crawl-delay: 1 - a longer gap than the 500 ms proposed in ats-config.ts. The payload carries NO employer name; employer evidence is the posting text naming the employer. Observed drift from the documentation: workplaceType is "onsite" on the live API, the README lists "on-site"; createdAt is present on every posting but is not in the README's field list. E-mail addresses and phone numbers inside string values were replaced by a parser; personal NAMES in free-text descriptions cannot be found by a parser and were not redacted (records were chosen with short descriptions to limit exposure).
